resources.string:
Bluetooth Mic Router 1.0.0

Open source, maintained by Roberto Jr Dev. Based on BTMicFix by Doug Lynch (Endda).
Source: https://github.com/robertojrdev/bluetooth-mic-router

No internet access, microphone recording, analytics, root or Shizuku.

%1$s
Headset for tile and automatic mode

Automatic mode is enabled by default when you open the app with Bluetooth permission. It watches recording status, never audio. It may react to any microphone app, including dictation or camera recording. Choose one headset for it. Routing stops 5 seconds after recording ends, or at the session limit. A timed-out recording must stop before another automatic session starts.

Stop or the tile disables it until you enable it again or reopen the app. It does not restart after reboot or if Android stops it.

Duration and headset changes apply to the next session. Reapply keeps the original deadline; Add 5 minutes extends it.

Connect a headset that supports calls and grant Nearby devices permission. Automatic mode starts when you open the app, then selects your headset when a microphone app starts recording.\n\nSessions stop after 5 minutes by default. Change the timer or headset in Routing settings. Use the Headset mic tile to turn routing on or off.

No audio recording, internet access or analytics. Silent playback keeps the headset call path active while routing; this uses battery and can reduce media quality. Android or another app can still change the route.
Grant Nearby devices permission to select a headset.
No SCO/HFP or BLE headset communication device is available. Connect a headset that supports calls, then refresh.
